title: Lactic Acidosis: Perfusion Versus Alternative Causes
subject: Hematology & ABG
preview: Lactate can rise with tissue hypoperfusion but also with seizures, beta-agonists, hepatic impairment or other causes.
quickRevision: Lactate can rise with tissue hypoperfusion but also with seizures, beta-agonists, hepatic impairment or other causes.
Acid–base interpretation requires pH, bicarbonate, respiratory compensation and anion-gap context.
Reassess perfusion, oxygen delivery, medications and the underlying cause rather than treating a number in isolation.

sections.title: Interpret the result in context
points: Lactate can rise with tissue hypoperfusion but also with seizures, beta-agonists, hepatic impairment or other causes.
Serial lactate and the overall clinical picture are more informative than labeling every elevated value as septic shock.

sections.title: Clinical interpretation & next steps
points: Acid–base interpretation requires pH, bicarbonate, respiratory compensation and anion-gap context.
Reassess perfusion, oxygen delivery, medications and the underlying cause rather than treating a number in isolation.

sections.title: Exam trap — avoid this mistake
points: Lactic acidosis is not synonymous with sepsis, and lactate alone does not diagnose hypoperfusion.

quiz.question: Which statement about elevated lactate is correct?
options: It has causes beyond tissue hypoxia
quiz.explanation: It has causes beyond tissue hypoxia. Lactate can rise with tissue hypoperfusion but also with seizures, beta-agonists, hepatic impairment or other causes.
